summary: Phase M — Retention & reinvestment engine tested end-to-end. Backend pytest (/app/backend/tests/test_phase_m.py): 10/12 PASS. 2 failures on reinvest for paid investments whose original opportunity's crop+region has NO matching open opportunity (Maize/Kaduna — no open Maize or Kaduna cycle in demo DB). Frontend Playwright (preview URL) PASS: login → /app/my-investments renders [my-investments-page], capital-at-work=₦1,260,000, 4 active-inv cards with 4 progress-* bars, 3 paid-inv cards, live-feed with 15 feed-item-*, milestones-card with 7 badge-* (all 7 ids present: first_invest, three_invests, ten_invests, hundred_k, million, first_payout, diversified), idle-funds-banner correctly NOT rendered (4 active cycles). Nav has 'My investments' entry between Home and Opportunities. paid-reinvest-fc984ce2 (Tomato/Ogun) click → POST /investments/{id}/reinvest → navigated to /app/opportunities/3b527301...?prefill=200000 with invest-amount-input pre-filled with '200000'. Portfolio /app/portfolio inline reinvest-* buttons also work (3 present, Tomato one navigates with prefill). Regression: /investments/mine, /investments/summary, /wallet all 200.

minor.issue: Returns 404 'No open opportunity available to reinvest' when the paid investment's opportunity was closed AND no open opp matches crop OR region. In the demo, 2 of 3 paid investments are Maize/Kaduna — no open Maize or Kaduna opp exists, so the one-click reinvest from the paid-card breaks for those rows. The retention loop promise ('falls back to a similar cycle if original closed') is broken for orthogonal crop/region. Fallback should further widen (ANY open opp) rather than 404 when crop/region has no match.

ui_bugs.issue: React console warning: 'Encountered two children with the same key' for synthesised feed ids (e.g. 3b527301-...-syn-35). Cause: backend feed loops per investment; when the investor has >1 investment in the same opportunity (active + paid in 3b527301 Tomato), identical synth IDs are emitted. Dedupe feed items by (opportunity_id, stage, days) server-side, or dedupe opportunities before synthesis.

action_items: Backend: broaden reinvest fallback — if no crop/region match exists among open opps, pick ANY status='open' opp (sorted by target_return_pct desc or funding_raised) before returning 404. Currently 2/3 paid investments in demo (Maize/Kaduna) fail the one-click reinvest, breaking the stated retention loop promise.

Backend: dedupe feed items by opportunity_id when synthesising — /investments/mine/feed iterates per investment, so an investor with 2 investments in the same opportunity gets duplicate synth feed IDs (`{opp_id}-syn-{days}`), triggering React duplicate-key warnings on the client. Suggested fix: collapse invs by opportunity_id at top of my_investments_feed before the for-loop.
critical_code_review_comments: phase_h.py my_investments_feed iterates per investment rather than per unique opportunity — O(n) duplicate work + duplicate synth ids when investor has multiple invs in same opp. Collapse to `unique_opp_ids = {i['opportunity_id'] for i in invs}` then iterate.

phase_h.py reinvest fallback `$or: [{crop}, {region}]` is too narrow — a paid investor in Maize/Kaduna with no open Maize or Kaduna cycle gets 404 ('Browse marketplace'), which defeats the one-click retention loop. Add a second fallback: if no crop/region match, pick any `status=='open'` opp.

MyInvestments.jsx line 74: idle banner gated on balance≥10k AND activeRows.length===0. Current demo has 4 active + balance 828k → correctly NOT rendered. But if investor has only paid (no active) + balance≥10k, the banner will render — good UX per spec.

MyInvestments.jsx line 82 navigates via react-router (good). InvestorPortfolio uses window.location.href per agent note (acceptable given Link wrapper + stopPropagation) but inconsistent — consider event.preventDefault() + useNavigate() there too for SPA behaviour.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase M frontend is 100% working. Two backend polish items remain: (1) reinvest fallback too narrow (fails for Maize/Kaduna paid invs), (2) feed synth duplicate-key issue for investors with >1 inv in same opp. Neither blocks the happy path — the Tomato/Ogun paid-reinvest flow works end-to-end with prefill. Test suite at /app/backend/tests/test_phase_m.py covers 12 assertions; after fixes, expect 12/12. The reinvest tests intentionally pick the first paid inv (Maize/Kaduna) to exercise the fallback — after fix, it should 200 with a suggested_opportunity_id pointing to any open opp.
rca of the issue: Reinvest 404 RCA: in phase_h.py:275-282, the fallback query filters `$or: [{crop: opp.crop}, {region: opp.region}]` AFTER status='open'. Demo's Maize/Kaduna closed opp has no open counterpart (only open opps are Cassava/Oyo, Tomato/Ogun, Rice/Kebbi). Fix: nest the fallback — first try crop/region match; if empty, drop the $or and select any status=='open' opp. Duplicate feed keys RCA: phase_h.py:192 `for inv in invs` iterates per investment; when 2 invs share one opp, synth IDs `{opp.id}-syn-{days}` collide. Fix: pre-compute `seen_opps = set(); for inv in invs: if inv['opportunity_id'] in seen_opps: continue; seen_opps.add(...)` before the opp lookup, or dedupe `out` list by item id before returning.
